title: Implement an async retry helper
prompt: Create `retry.js` (CommonJS) exporting `async function retry(fn, attempts)`. It calls `fn()` (which returns a promise). If it resolves, return its value. If it rejects, retry up to `attempts` total tries. If all attempts reject, throw the LAST error. `attempts` defaults to 3. Do not add any delay between tries. The test file `verify.test.js` is present and must pass via `node --test verify.test.js`. Do NOT modify the test file.
